Security researchers at Claroc published a study analyzing 37,571 apps created using Grok.

They found that 35,000 of these applications were accessible online without requiring login credentials.

Approximately 10% of these open apps contained internal corporate or personal data, including medical information, employee directories, and confidential business documents.
